indicatorCode.description: Official indicator code from the funding source (e.g. KPI table row id).

indicatorName.description: Human label of the indicator as published by the funding source.

indicatorUnit.description: Measurement unit as published (e.g. 't CO2-eq', 'M EUR', 'jm', '%'); null when not specified.

indicatorCategory.description: Optional grouping of the indicator (environmental, economic, social, digital, other).

necessity.description: Whether the indicator always applies, is conditional, or is recommended.

conditionGroupId.description: Optional reference to an eligibility RuleGroup gating applicability of this indicator.

baseline.description: Baseline figure as published (free text when the source states it non-numerically).

targetValue.description: Numeric target when the source publishes a number; null when not specified.

targetDirection.description: Intended direction of the target when published.

targetPeriodType.description: Reporting period for the target when published.

evidenceId.description: FieldEvidence reference anchoring this indicator row to an immutable source document.

completenessStatus.description: Whether the indicator (and its target) is complete, partial, or unknown from the official source.

verificationStatus.description: Distinguishes official extracted fact from user input.

sortOrder.description: Deterministic ordering of indicators within a GrantCallVersion.
